inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL report joins a detail relation to its parent and groups JSON_ARRAYAGG values by the parent identifier.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored route manifest report. Routes join package stops, CONCAT_WS builds each package label, JSON_ARRAYAGG preserves duplicate labels within each route, and unique route ordering makes the grouped result deterministic without copying the source schema, rows, or business purpose.

fixture_notes: Route 10 has two identical package labels and must retain both array elements; route 20 has one distinct package label. The outer route ordering is unique, and duplicate array members make internal duplicate ordering unobservable.
determinism_notes: Route IDs and stop IDs are fixed; duplicate members in route 10 are byte-identical, so array order is not observable within that group. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE manifest_routes (route_id INT PRIMARY KEY, route_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE manifest_stops (stop_id INT PRIMARY KEY, route_id INT NOT NULL, package_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, carrier VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO manifest_routes VALUES (10, 'north loop'), (20, 'south loop')

steps.sql: SELECT r.route_id, r.route_name, JSON_ARRAYAGG(CONCAT_WS(':', s.package_code, s.carrier)) AS packages FROM manifest_routes r INNER JOIN manifest_stops s ON s.route_id = r.route_id GROUP BY r.route_id, r.route_name ORDER BY r.route_id
